instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Instruction alone does not give tip-binding, revoke precedence, or disk-vs-memory root rule; solver must engage C/Rust/Go code and reload behavior.

discovery_budget.discovery: Host reload re-reads the on-disk policy root under data/roots/; the broken Go path keeps the pre-rotation in-memory root so accept flips to reject (or the reverse) after reload.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the disk-vs-memory root split collapses diagnose to a one-line Go patch.

discovery_budget.discovery: Revoke epoch beats prior-generation local verify inside the freshness window (stale_chain); outside the window the reason is revoked. Signature OK alone must not admit.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating the precedence table turns the Rust gate into recipe transcription.

discovery_budget.discovery: Sibling gen_skew is decided by parent-hash tip continuity on the C capsule frame, not by leaf signature match that surfcheck and skim_frame validate.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Telling solvers the tip-binding rule removes the discoverability tax and makes surfcheck bait useless.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Reports local-ok/post-reload refuse, sibling disagreement, and surfcheck false greens; omits algorithms, precedence, and fix loci.

attack_path.summary: Inspect surfcheck vs enroll path → recover tip binding in fold_q → fix revoke/freshness in gate_r → fix disk root rebind in slot_w → rebuild and emit ledger.
attack_path.reasoning: Partial fixes leave sibling skew, stale_chain, or reload drift failing.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Oracle rewrites three decision bodies (fold_q, gate_r, slot_w) totaling ≥80 substantive LOC across C/Rust/Go, then make + run-enroll.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Each body encodes a distinct authority rule; none is a flag flip.
